title: docs(design): Studio design-surface reference artboards for the layout redesign (epic #12446)
body:
## What

The visual contract for the Studio design-surface layout redesign tracked by #12446: eight static artboards under `docs/design/studio-redesign/` (plain HTML with inline styles, each with a 1280 px PNG render) and a README that maps every artboard to its child card and lists the shared numbers those cards cite.

Documentation only. No source file, test, changeset or build input changes; `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` reports no changeset owed.

## Why

The ten child cards restate their artboard in numbers so a developer never needs the private design canvas. This folder gives the lane the same thing as pixels and as readable HTML (each declaration maps to one Tailwind utility), and gives acceptance a fixed image to compare PR screenshots against. The README's last section says what a PR against a card must show.

## Authorization

The PM seat writes no files; this PR is the maintainer's per-PR exception, granted in the epic PM session on 2026-10-15, verbatim:

> 授权：你在 objectui 开一个只含 docs/design/studio-redesign/ 参考稿（静态 HTML + PNG + README）的 PR，不改任何代码；合并后给十张子卡补 Reference artboard 行。

Once this merges, each child card gets a "Reference artboard" line pointing at its file here.

Part of #12446.
